integrity: Proof and exact labelled recurrence are included, with a standalone finite exhaustive comparison checker. No independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: All frame statements concern finite nonempty rooted trees with only immediate outward parent-to-child accessibility and classical unconstrained valuations.
No extension to arbitrary directed graphs, shared-successor DAGs, reflexive closures, or transitive closures is asserted.
Numerical constants are approximations to roots of explicit equations and are not certified interval enclosures.
An older relevant 2015 noncontingency paper was accessible only at catalogue/abstract level and remains a historical-priority risk.
title: Noncontingency introspection on finite out-trees: forbidden branches and exact labelled enumeration
